name: Velvet Sky
summary:
Leave the rush behind and settle into a comfortable bed under the night sky.

Choose your place: a beach beside the sea, rose-colored desert dunes, or a jungle canopy overlooking a waterfall. Warm ambient music accompanies each scene, with quiet natural surf on the beach.
